summary.text: Sarah Woodson is the Democratic candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 42 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after defeating incumbent Mandy Lindsay in the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary.
A small business owner, she named teacher diversity, early mental health care and the arts as her key campaign messages in a Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Sarah Woodson said her "north star in public policy is supporting small businesses," and she described herself as a small business owner.
She said she supports a "Care Before Crisis" approach that prioritizes early intervention, community-based mental health services and preventive care.

She also said she believes educators who reflect the students they serve improve student success, and that investing in the arts and performing arts supports economic and community development in Aurora.
